acceptanceCriteria: A spec in the flow-documentation domain defines the inventory input with numbered requirements and failure modes.
generate --flows produces exactly the declared flows, aggregating member observations, proven by a test.
Unresolved members and unassigned declarations are reported, proven by a test.
check reports fresh/stale/unresolved against inventory identities, proven by a test.
body: GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1478. generate makes one flow per extracted declaration in --scope; a Rails service dir of ~60 files produced 56 flows. Requested: optional --flows FILE of {id,title,members:[{path,symbol?}],entry_points?}; each declared flow aggregates its members' observations; unresolved members reported, not dropped; unassigned in-scope declarations listed rather than turned into flows; check keeps per-claim fresh/stale/unresolved on the same identities.
